request.title: Never stored: carries a removed scope key
request.summary: A capture naming another repository by a removed key is refused.
request.content: Refused before any KB is resolved, so nothing is written anywhere.

error.message: E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED: kb_capture no longer accepts 'repo_remote_url' (removed in the KB redesign); the call was not run and no KB was changed. Remediation: repo_remote_url: nothing -- drop it: a remote member's KB identity is its registered origin remote (record it with update_member git_repos) and is resolved from the calling member session.
